description: A 5 minute timer, a 10 minute timer, or any timer online — with an alarm. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

hours.description: The hours part of the duration. The three parts are added together and capped at 24 hours in total, then returned as milliseconds, as h:mm:ss text and as parts.

minutes.description: The minutes part of the duration. Defaults to 5, so an empty request is 05:00.

seconds.description: The seconds part of the duration.

name: countdown_timer
title: Countdown Timer
